name: Matt Motherway
summary: Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 15 years' experience building scalable, secure, high-performance applications. Proficient in TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, with expertise in API design, financial service integration, and workflow optimization. Collaborates across teams, architects robust systems, and mentors engineers. Passionate about sovereign technologies, focusing on sound, security-conscious engineering. Recognized for code quality, maintainability, and continuous system improvement.
